name: TEI input-length histogram
notes: Matcher::Full("te_request_input_length") with buckets (0..20).map(2^i).filter(<= max_input_length). The bucket list is therefore DEPLOYMENT-DEPENDENT: it is filtered against the router's --max-input-length at startup, so the ladder on one deployment is not the ladder on another. This record's list is the ladder for max_input_length = 512, which yields bounds 1,2,4,...,512 (10 bounds). A reader quantiling this histogram must know the serving --max-input-length or the interpolation is wrong - the same failure mode as vLLM's request_tokens family.
